Subject: [Quantum Health] Request: GCP listing intake + co-sell sync

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking the intro call last week. We attached a short opportunity brief (see quantumhealth_opportunity_brief.pdf) and would like to move into the marketplace intake flow for a GCP listing. High-level:

- Use case: payer-provider search + AI routing for benefit navigation
- Target launch: Q4 2026 pilot with 10k monthly active users
- Expected TPV: initial pilot $30k/month -> expansion on product-market fit

We want to confirm the right GCP co-sell path and prioritize any technical checklist items before the listing submission. Can we do a 30–45m intake/prioritization huddle early next week? Preferred windows: Tue/Wed morning PST.

Attachments: quantumhealth_opportunity_brief.pdf

Thanks — Maria

Proposed agenda for the 30–45m huddle:
- Quick opportunity context (5m)
- GCP listing prerequisites and timeline (10m)
- Co-sell qualification and roles (who owns what) (10m)
- Technical blocker review (networking/KMS/audit logs) (10m)
- Next steps and owners (5m)

Vanessa, Karthik, Laura — can you join a sync? Vanessa can lead the co-sell qualification; Karthik and Laura can triage listing readiness and technical blockers. I attached the GCP intake checklist (gcp_listing_intake_checklist.xlsx) to speed the review.

Maria — are you ok with Wed 2026-09-15 09:30–10:15 PT? If that works we’ll send a calendar invite (I can also shift to Tue morning if needed).

Thanks,

+1 to Wed 9:30 PT. Quick notes after skimming the brief:
- Co-sell fit: looks promising for GCP sales engagement (payer workload + partner ecosystem tie-ins). We should capture the specific customer references they will list; those speed validation.
- Security ask: they mention KMS and audit logs — need to confirm whether their deployment will use Redwood Private or Hosted with VPC connectors. If Private, we need the network diagram (qhsla_dataflow_diagram.png) and SOC2 evidence.
- Marketplace ops: Quantum Health should confirm billing owner and expected SKU granularity (pilot vs GA).

Prep requests (please bring to the huddle):
- Maria: any existing GCP Marketplace account IDs and the billing contact
- Karthik/Laura: quick pass on the checklist and call out anything that will block listing (service account scopes, VPC peering, IP allowlists)

I’ll run the co-sell qualification portion and capture the mutual action plan.
